card.name: Linking words in analytical chemistry methods
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, the, using, for, by and of inside descriptions of chemical separation or assay methods (extraction, chromatography, reagents). It also fires on a few word pieces in the same lab-method text.

modes.label: Linking words in extraction text
modes.description: Prepositions and articles in phrases about selective extraction of metal ions.
modes.example: Selective extraction of gold(III)<< in>> the presence of Pd(II)

modes.label: Linking words in chromatography steps
modes.description: Words like using or the before a named reagent, strip or method in a lab procedure.
modes.example: Perform ITLC using ITLC SG strips and<< using>> ammonium acetate 1M:

card.writes: It seems to push toward word endings and pieces such as -ify and -ute, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in descriptions of lab chemistry methods like extraction and chromatography.
